brief: A recipe manager as a transformation timeline — ingredients flow through steps and combine into the dish

dominant_strengths: Earthy olive/cream/amber palette feels appropriately culinary and supports a warm, appetizing emotional tone throughout
Clear three-column architecture with a vertical timeline spine effectively communicates sequential transformation of ingredients into dish
Consistent pill/tag system for ingredients per step gives steady rhythm and reinforces the flow metaphor cleanly
dominant_weaknesses: Brief promises ingredients 'flowing' and 'combining' but the visual is a static numbered list — no actual flow lines from left ingredients into steps
Right-side recipe card is decorative summary rather than a destination; the transformation never visually culminates in the final dish
Typography is competent but generic — same weight/scale relationships as any recipe app, missing distinctive editorial voice
fix_priorities: Draw literal connector strands from ingredient chips on the left into the step pills they appear in to honor the transformation metaphor
Make the final dish card the terminus of the timeline, with steps visually converging into it rather than sitting parallel
Differentiate step typography (numerals as display, step titles heavier) to give the timeline narrative cadence
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral warmth and behavioral clarity are solid, but reflective payoff is weak because the promised transformation narrative never resolves visually.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially — it's a competent vertical recipe timeline, but ingredients don't actually flow or combine, so the core conceptual brief is under-delivered.
